hints: Reproduce it with the device mode of the DevTools at 375 px. Which element is wider than the screen: the page, the grid, or each card? Hover the elements in the Elements panel to see their boxes.
The grid decides its own columns: "as many as fit, each at least this wide". What happens to that rule when the screen is narrower than the minimum width of one column?

Look at the `grid-cols-[…]` class in `client/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx`. A minimum in pixels inside `minmax()` is a width the column will never go below, even when the screen is smaller. The minimum can be the smaller of two values: `min(100%, …)`.
